title: Matcha Crumble Mochi
description: A Japanese-inspired dessert featuring a matcha-infused mochi cake topped with a crunchy almond crumble.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together almond meal, matcha paste, and granulated sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 18-20 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden.
While the mochi cake is baking, prepare the crumble topping.
In a small bowl, mix together almond meal, powdered sugar, and melted butter until well combined.
Remove the mochi cake from the oven and sprinkle the crumble topping evenly over the top.
Return to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the crumble is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
